payload.note: The complete order-g^4 cancellation gate now has an exact Wiener-chaos reduction. In the square-root background-density normal form, M4=||D||_0^2+2<A,E>_0. At nonzero external momentum A is a centered quadratic polynomial and lies purely in chaos 2; D has chaoses 1,3,5 and E has chaoses 0,2,4,6,8. Hence M4=||D||_0^2+2<A,Pi2(E)>_0: every potentially negative contribution is localized to one effective second-chaos three-leg kernel, while all other terms form a nonnegative norm. The certified cubic norm is O(N omega_p^2 log L), so a bound ||Pi2(E)||^2<=C N omega_p (1+log L)^b for any fixed b makes the cross term o(N omega_p) and proves survival of the positive UV power. This bound remains open. The active gate is to Wick-contract C-W1 B/2+(W1^2/8-W2/2-z2/2)A as one combined kernel before estimating hard, one-soft, and all-soft regions.
